notes.title: Bug Fix - V1
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

There's a short term simple fix for the level not finishing/loading bug if you encounter it,
Restart the game, once restarted it should work, sometimes the first boot of the game doesn't work. 

We are looking into consistently replicating the bug and fixing it,

Thank you,

Vox Studios

notes.title: BUG FOUND - V1
notes.content:
Hi All, 

Thank you very much for buying our game and supporting us,

This is our first game release and we didn't quite know how it was going to turn out! We think a few builds have got muddled up during the upload process and we have uploaded the bugged unfinished version.

We are working hard to find the correct version and will get it reuploaded and pushed to be updated by the end of the week LATEST.

Thank you for your patience and understanding,

Vox Studios
